metadata.title: Ruhi 2D Graph NLP training + evaluation corpus (pilot)
metadata.purpose: Train/test intent understanding, action grounding, multi-turn memory, clarification, correction, and mathematical 2D graph operations. Expected outcomes are semantic contracts, not required engine API signatures.

schema_notes.context: Fixture for replay; context describes simulated workspace/dialogue state, not always actual constructed geometry
schema_notes.expected.actions: Semantic action plan; adapter maps op names to real application actions
schema_notes.follow_up: When provided, do not execute until missing slot is resolved
schema_notes.scenario_id: Records with same scenario_id should be executed in ID order, keeping dialogue state. Other records are standalone.

evaluation.split_rule: Split by scenario_id, never individual turns, to avoid leakage
evaluation.test_policy: Held-out test stays sealed during training; use validation for iterative improvement, then final held-out test
evaluation.safety: Never blindly execute reference commands; enforce geometry constraints and no silent assumptions

known_limitations: Some records use illustrative semantic context or symbolic vertices, so a test harness must seed a matching workspace fixture.
Clarification cases are short 2-turn examples; real interactive testing should additionally verify paraphrased answers and interleaved dialogue.
Repeated structures are deliberate coverage seeds, not 300 fully unique concepts.
